title: NVIDIA cuDSS Now Generally Available to Accelerate Engineering and Scientific Simulations

claims.claim: NVIDIA cuDSS, bugün genel kullanıma sunulmuş bir NVIDIA CUDA-X kütüphanesidir.

evidence.quote: NVIDIA cuDSS, launched today in general availability, is an NVIDIA CUDA-X library that shifts a critical part of engineering and scientific simulations onto GPUs.

claims.claim: Applied Materials, Ginestra platformunda cuDSS kullanarak seyrek çözümleri CPU tabanlı yaklaşımlara kıyasla 10 kata kadar hızlandırmıştır.

evidence.quote: Applied Materials: With cuDSS, Applied Materials accelerated sparse solves in Ginestra, its physics-based, defect-centric simulation platform, by up to 10x versus CPU-only approaches, speeding exploration of semiconductor materials and device reliability.

claims.claim: ZEISS SMT, NVIDIA cuDSS kullanarak bir EUV litografi plazma simülasyonu benchmark testinde 4 kat hız artışı elde etmiş ve simülasyonu 6 gün 14 saatte tamamlamıştır.

evidence.quote: Using COMSOL Multiphysics with NVIDIA cuDSS on NVIDIA accelerated computing, ZEISS SMT achieved a measured 4x speedup in an EUV lithography plasma simulation benchmark, completing the full simulation in six days and 14 hours.

- COMSOL: Using COMSOL Multiphysics with NVIDIA cuDSS on NVIDIA accelerated computing, ZEISS SMT achieved a measured 4x speedup in an EUV lithography plasma simulation benchmark, completing the full simulation in six days and 14 hours.

claims.claim: Dassault Systèmes, Abaqus structural ve computer simulation technology elektromanyetik çözücülerinde cuDSS kullanarak 8 ile 10 kat arasında bir hızlanma bildirmektedir.

evidence.quote: Dassault Systèmes: Dassault Systèmes reports an 8-10x speedup using cuDSS within its Abaqus structural and computer simulation technology electromagnetic solvers for performance-critical simulations across industries.

claims.claim: Geliştiriciler cuDSS'yi C, C++, Python ve Fortran arayüzleri aracılığıyla kullanabilirler.

evidence.quote: They can use cuDSS through C, C++, Python and Fortran interfaces.
